scope_statement: Hinges, rolling and gliding described in plain terms.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, the knowledge base or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: The knee is more than a hinge: it rolls and glides at the same time.
Rolling alone would carry the thigh bone off the back of the shin bone.
The knee also twists a few degrees, most when bent and least when straight.
At full straightening the joint locks, so standing costs little muscle effort.
Twisting on a planted foot is how many sports injuries happen.
